description_en: Queries information about access point (AP) devices
kebab_example: aliyun cloudesl describe-ap-devices --store-id s-dxsxx0000 --ap-mac 112233445566 --status true --page-size 10 --page-number 1 --model aliyun --be-activate false --extra-params example-string --api-version 2020-02-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApDevices

parameters.help_en: The store ID or the custom store ID defined by the merchant
parameters.help_zh: 门店ID或商家自定义门店ID
parameters.name: store_id

parameters.help_en: The MAC address of the AP device
parameters.name: ap_mac

parameters.help_en:
The online or offline status of the device. Valid values:
true: online.
false: offline
parameters.help_zh: 设备在线或离线状态 ，true：在线、false：离线
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页参数：每页显示条数，默认值10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 分页参数：当前页码，默认值1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The activation status of the device
parameters.name: be_activate

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. Ignore this parameter
parameters.name: extra_params
